headlines.title: US says Europe should ready fuel supplies as Trump threatens diesel ban
headlines.summary: President Donald Trump has threatened to ban diesel exports in a bid to ease prices in the US ahead of the November elections.

headlines.title: José Sevilla resigns as Unicaja chair and declines to remain at the bank
headlines.summary: José Sevilla will step down as Unicaja chairman in April 2027 after deciding not to seek a new term, but will retain his non-executive role at the Málaga-based bank until then.

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: Israel’s Herzog calls British sanctions a ‘grave mistake,’ accuses UK of election interference
headlines.summary: The Israeli president accused Britain of interfering in his country’s politics ahead of an election in which Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is seeking another term.

headlines.title: 'It could cost me £10k but I need the money now': Why Gen Z are opting out of pensions
headlines.summary: A growing number of people are opting out of these schemes due to cost-of-living pressures.

headlines.title: EU watchdogs question Binance over unlicensed European operations
headlines.summary: European regulators are questioning Binance over its use of a narrow legal exemption to keep serving EU customers without a licence, the Financial Times reported. Binance told Euronews it is working towards authorisation, while ESMA said enforcement is a matter for national authorities.

headlines.title: Is US President Donald Trump right to rename AI as Super Intelligence ?
headlines.summary: Donald Trump thinks the name artificial intelligence sounds fake and has ordered US agencies to use Super Intelligence instead. Yet, tech firms and researchers have little reason to play along.

headlines.title: Albania s PM to US Democrats: Don t use us to get revenge on Trump
headlines.summary: Edi Rama's comments come as protests over a luxury resort linked to Trump's son-in-law enter their fourth month.

headlines.title: What's gone wrong at Nike? How the world's sportswear giant lost its mojo
headlines.summary: Several self-inflicted mistakes have cost the biggest sportswear brand on the planet in recent years.

headlines.title: Portugal records biggest EU rise in house prices in second quarter
headlines.summary: Eurostat data shows Portugal recorded the EU's sharpest rise in house prices in Q2 2026 versus a year earlier. In September, national housing costs hit a fresh record high.

headlines.title: Global trade weathers Iran, Ukraine and Trump s tariffs
headlines.summary: Over the past six years, COVID, two wars and Donald Trump s tariffs have shaken world trade. With globalization already stalling, is this a temporary shock or the start of a great reversal?

headlines.title: As Germany’s far right rises, weakened Merz looks to project strength and resolve against Putin
headlines.summary: In a closely watched speech, the chancellor sought to reassure worried allies in Europe and Ukraine while warning Germans to stay the course against Moscow, lest Russia’s war machine ‘turn against us.’

headlines.title: HMRC urged to scrutinise tax implications of Man City case
headlines.summary: The Treasury Committee, which is responsible for overseeing HMRC, has urged the body to scrutinise tax implications of the Manchester City verdict.

headlines.title: Before the Iran war vs now: How much of a worker’s wage is needed to fill a 50-litre tank?
headlines.summary: A 50-litre diesel tank costs the equivalent of 15.4% of Bulgaria’s gross monthly minimum wage, compared with 3.8% in Luxembourg, as fuel prices have risen since the Iran war began.

headlines.title: Diesel prices are surging putting further pressure on Europe
headlines.summary: Trucks, farms and industry are powered with diesel. Now prices are soaring due to refinery disruptions, supply shortages and geopolitical tensions. A potential US export ban could make Europe s diesel crunch even worse.

headlines.title: EU ministers explore new emergency migration measures
headlines.summary: Athens proposes temporarily suspending asylum applications in emergency situations — and the idea has support from Berlin and Vienna.

headlines.title: PM warned Rosebank oil field could breach West Bank sanctions
headlines.summary: Campaigners and Green Party leader Zack Polanski raise concerns about Rosebank's ties to an Israeli firm.

headlines.title: TAP: final bids from Air France-KLM and Lufthansa have been submitted
headlines.summary: Air France-KLM and Lufthansa submitted their final bids on Wednesday to buy a 44.9% stake in TAP, closing the bidding phase and leaving the decision to the government.

headlines.title: British-Iranian man arrested in RAF Fairford investigation
headlines.summary: A 25-year-old man who is a dual U.K./Iranian national was arrested on Thursday on suspicion of preparation of terrorist acts.

headlines.title: The wealthy Cuban Americans ready and waiting for Havana to fall
headlines.summary: Cuban exiles in Florida are increasingly hopeful that regime change in Cuba is now on the horizon.
